title: Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in context

sections.skill: Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in context

questions.skill: Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in context
questions.prompt: Renting a bike costs C = 4h + 10 dollars for h hours. What do the 4 and the 10 mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
Renting a bike costs C = 4h + 10 dollars for h hours.
What do the 4 and the 10 mean?
questions.correct_answer: 4: the cost goes up $4 for each hour. 10: a $10 fee (the cost at 0 hours).

questions.skill: Interpret the rate of change and initial value of a linear function in context
questions.prompt: The graph shows the water in a tank. What do the rate of change and the initial value mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
The graph shows the water in a tank.
What do the rate of change and the initial value mean?
questions.correct_answer: The tank starts with 60 gallons (initial value) and drains 10 gallons per minute (rate of change -10).
